theorems.name: watchdog_stops_when_overdue
theorems.doc: **S.** An armed watchdog whose last active motion command is more than 300 ms old stops the wheels and disarms.
theorems.statement:
theorem watchdog_stops_when_overdue (w : Watchdog) (now : Std.U64)
    (ha : w.active = true) (ht : w.last_motion_ms.val + 300 < now.val) :
    ∃ w', watchdog_trip w now = ok (w', true) ∧ w'.active = false
theorems.proof:
theorem watchdog_stops_when_overdue (w : Watchdog) (now : Std.U64)
    (ha : w.active = true) (ht : w.last_motion_ms.val + 300 < now.val) :
    ∃ w', watchdog_trip w now = ok (w', true) ∧ w'.active = false := by
  have spec : watchdog_trip w now ⦃ r => r.2 = true ∧ r.1.active = false ⦄ := by
    unfold watchdog_trip MOTION_WATCHDOG_MS
    simp only [ha, if_true]
    all_goals (try split)
    all_goals (try step*)
    all_goals (try split)
    all_goals (try step*)
    all_goals (try split)
    all_goals (try step*)
    all_goals first | (simp_all; done) | scalar_tac | (simp_all; scalar_tac)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, h1, h2⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 spec
  obtain ⟨w', b⟩ := r
  simp only at h1 h2
  subst h1
  exact ⟨w', hr, h2⟩

theorems.name: watchdog_quiet_when_disarmed
theorems.doc: **C.** A disarmed watchdog never stops anything.
theorems.statement:
theorem watchdog_quiet_when_disarmed (w : Watchdog) (now : Std.U64)
    (ha : w.active = false) : watchdog_trip w now = ok (w, false)
theorems.proof:
theorem watchdog_quiet_when_disarmed (w : Watchdog) (now : Std.U64)
    (ha : w.active = false) : watchdog_trip w now = ok (w, false) := by
  unfold watchdog_trip
  simp [ha]

theorems.name: active_command_arms
theorems.doc: **S.** An active motion command arms the watchdog at its time.
theorems.statement:
theorem active_command_arms (w : Watchdog) (now : Std.U64) :
    watchdog_on_command w MotionKind.Active now = ok { active := true, last_motion_ms := now }
theorems.proof:
theorem active_command_arms (w : Watchdog) (now : Std.U64) :
    watchdog_on_command w MotionKind.Active now = ok { active := true, last_motion_ms := now } := by
  unfold watchdog_on_command
  rfl

theorems.name: held_lease_not_taken
theorems.doc: **S.** A controller seen within the last 30 s keeps the slot.
theorems.statement:
theorem held_lease_not_taken (last now : Std.U64) (h : now.val ≤ last.val + 30) :
    may_acquire (some last) now = ok false
theorems.proof:
theorem held_lease_not_taken (last now : Std.U64) (h : now.val ≤ last.val + 30) :
    may_acquire (some last) now = ok false := by
  have spec : may_acquire (some last) now ⦃ r => r = false ⦄ := by
    unfold may_acquire SESSION_TIMEOUT_SECS
    simp only
    all_goals (try split)
    all_goals (try step*)
    all_goals (try split)
    all_goals (try step*)
    all_goals (try split)
    all_goals (try step*)
    all_goals first | (simp_all; done) | scalar_tac | (simp_all; scalar_tac)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 spec
  rw [hr, hp]

theorems.name: closed_surface_needs_the_secret
theorems.doc: **S.** Unless the surface was explicitly opened, a WebSocket is authorized only with a configured secret that matches.
theorems.statement:
theorem closed_surface_needs_the_secret (s m : Bool)
    (h : verify false s m = ok true) : s = true ∧ m = true
theorems.proof:
theorem closed_surface_needs_the_secret (s m : Bool)
    (h : verify false s m = ok true) : s = true ∧ m = true := by
  unfold verify at h
  cases s <;> cases m <;> simp_all

theorems.name: idle_wait_bounds
theorems.statement:
theorem idle_wait_bounds (d now : Std.U64) :
    ∃ w, idle_wait d now = ok w ∧ 1 ≤ w.val ∧ w.val ≤ 10
theorems.proof:
theorem idle_wait_bounds (d now : Std.U64) :
    ∃ w, idle_wait d now = ok w ∧ 1 ≤ w.val ∧ w.val ≤ 10 := by
  have spec : idle_wait d now ⦃ w => 1 ≤ w.val ∧ w.val ≤ 10 ⦄ := by
    unfold idle_wait COMMAND_IDLE_POLL_MS MOTION_WATCHDOG_POLL_MS
    all_goals (try split)
    all_goals (try step*)
    all_goals (try split)
    all_goals (try step*)
    all_goals (try split)
    all_goals (try step*)
    all_goals first | (simp_all; done) | scalar_tac | (simp_all; scalar_tac)
  exact (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 spec

idle_wait.lean:
def idle_wait
  (next_deadline : Std.U64) (now_ms : Std.U64) : Result Std.U64 := do
  let w ← if next_deadline > now_ms
            then next_deadline - now_ms
            else ok 0#u64
  let w1 ← if w > COMMAND_IDLE_POLL_MS
             then ok COMMAND_IDLE_POLL_MS
             else ok w
  let w2 ←
    if w1 > MOTION_WATCHDOG_POLL_MS
    then ok MOTION_WATCHDOG_POLL_MS
    else ok w1
  if w2 < 1#u64
  then ok 1#u64
  else ok w2
idle_wait.upstream_note: wait_ms: saturating_sub, min both poll caps, max 1

verify.lean:
def verify
  (open_surface : Bool) (secret_set : Bool) («matches» : Bool) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  if open_surface
  then ok true
  else if secret_set
       then ok «matches»
       else ok false
verify.upstream_note: verify_control_secret: open surface, else a configured secret that matches

may_acquire.lean:
def may_acquire
  (held_last_seen : Option Std.U64) (now_secs : Std.U64) : Result Bool := do
  match held_last_seen with
  | none => ok true
  | some last =>
    let age ← if now_secs > last
                then now_secs - last
                else ok 0#u64
    ok (age > SESSION_TIMEOUT_SECS)
may_acquire.upstream_note: try_acquire_session: refuse while a held lease was seen within the timeout

Watchdog.lean:
structure Watchdog where
  active : Bool
  last_motion_ms : Std.U64

MotionKind.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive MotionKind where
| Other : MotionKind
| Stop : MotionKind
| Active : MotionKind
MotionKind.upstream_note: the arms_watchdog / is_active_motion_command classification: Other, Stop (armed, zero), Active

watchdog_trip.lean:
def watchdog_trip
  (w : Watchdog) (now_ms : Std.U64) : Result (Watchdog × Bool) := do
  if w.active
  then
    let age ←
      if now_ms > w.last_motion_ms
      then now_ms - w.last_motion_ms
      else ok 0#u64
    if age > MOTION_WATCHDOG_MS
    then ok ({ w with active := false }, true)
    else ok (w, false)
  else ok (w, false)
watchdog_trip.upstream_note: trip_motion_watchdog_if_idle; the stop_motion call is the returned bool
